name: travel-concierge
description: Search and book corporate travel and manage your itineraries. Find flights and hotels within policy, confirm bookings, pull up your trip details, and cancel plans that change — all from the conversation.

tools.name: search_flights
tools.description: Search for flights by origin, destination, and dates, returning options that fit the traveler's schedule and travel policy.

tools.name: book_hotel
tools.description: Book a hotel room for a given city and date range within the traveler's nightly rate limit.

tools.name: get_itinerary
tools.description: Retrieve the full itinerary for a trip, including flights, hotels, and confirmation numbers.

tools.name: cancel_booking
tools.description: Cancel an existing flight or hotel booking and return the cancellation status.
